message: Hey neighbors! I recently stumbled upon some great tips about home fires that remind me of simpler times—like gathering around a cozy campfire. 🔥 It's all about being prepared in a low-key way, which is a fun excuse to check our smoke alarms and chat with the family about fire safety. Just a little reminder that being ready doesn’t have to be stressful; it can be part of the fun! How do you keep your home safe?
